notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts: 1934 (a note cited on the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes 'Six Twenty-Six' with no URL, and the Osbornes Project) vs 1936 (register and firelookout.com). Left as a conflict. Township differs: the Forest Lookouts page gives 12S-8W-10; the Osbornes Project gives Tsp. 10 S., Rng. 8 W., Sec. 10. Not used. Removal wording differs: removed (register), destroyed (firelookout.com), abandoned by 1950 (Osbornes Project). The 20-foot figure is recorded as design only; no height_m because it is not clear whether it is pole length or cab-floor height. No source describes the site today and no access information was found. The brief's coordinates and 336.5 m elevation match the register (1,104 ft / 336 m). The Forest Lookouts page and the Osbornes-hosted Kemnow PDF carry the same text. No photos were added.
